# UIDrop

> UIDrop is a Chrome extension that captures the design system behind any website and turns it into structured, implementation-ready context for AI coding agents.

UIDrop inspects the rendered page in the browser and extracts its visual language: colors, typography, spacing, radii, shadows, gradients, layout patterns, component styles, and a full-page screenshot. It produces an AI-ready design brief that developers and designers can send directly to their preferred coding agent.

## Core workflow

1. Open a website in Chrome.
2. Snap the page with UIDrop.
3. Review its extracted design system and screenshot.
4. Copy or send the structured implementation brief to an AI coding agent.
5. Save the snap in the UIDrop Library for future research and comparison.

## Features

- Extract complete design systems from live, rendered websites
- Capture colors, typography, spacing, borders, radii, shadows, gradients, and component treatments
- Detect and isolate standout components, each with its own screenshot and implementation prompt
- Send full-page briefs or individual component prompts to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Lovable, Manus, and Cursor
- Save snaps in a searchable visual library
- Organize research with favorites, tags, and collections
- Compare two captured design systems side by side
- Analyze recurring colors, fonts, styles, and patterns across the saved library
- Export Figma tokens, CSS variables, Tailwind configuration, shadcn/ui themes, and Canva palettes
- Generate both prompt-style briefs and structured skill/system files for coding agents
- Detect light and dark visual systems from the rendered page

## Access and privacy

- Available as a Manifest V3 Chrome extension
- Core capture and design-system extraction run locally in the browser
- Page design data is not uploaded to a UIDrop-operated extraction server
- No account or API key is required for the free workflow
- Optional UIDrop Pro unlocks advanced library, comparison, insight, component-send, and export actions
- Purchases and license validation are handled through Polar
